description:
Get one time entry by id. You can read your own entries; managers can read anyone's. An id that does not belong to this property's organization, or that you may not read, returns not_found. Only @seoalive.com accounts can use the time tracking tools.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// read one entry by id.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","entry":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"}
```
name: get_time_entry

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.

title: Time entry detail
